messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Portuguese-language Guitar Hero-style game featuring a banjo.

## Requirements
- Implement the game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created “Banjo Hero” with a bluegrass song, four note lanes, keyboard and touch controls, synthesized pluck audio, scoring, streaks, accuracy, a star meter, and replay/pause controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the responsive game UI in `index.html` and `styles.css`.
- Implemented game logic, canvas rendering, chart, scoring, controls, and Web Audio in `game.js`.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check game.js`.
- Ran the game in Playwright and inspected desktop and mobile screenshots.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Optionally verify the game’s active gameplay and end-of-song flow in the browser.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and controls.
- `styles.css`: Visual design and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Gameplay, rendering, audio, scoring, and input.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started on port 3002; the latest screenshot at `screenshots/banjo-check.jpg` was captured at 390×844 and inspected.

## Banjo Hero pronto para jogar

Implementei um jogo estilo Guitar Hero em português, com tema bluegrass, quatro cordas, notas especiais, pontuação, sequência, precisão, brilho, pausa e recorde local. Os controles funcionam pelo teclado (**A, S, K, L**) ou pelos botões de toque; use **Espaço** para ativar o brilho quando a barra estiver cheia.

Arquivos principais: `index.html`, `styles.css` e `game.js`. Verifiquei a sintaxe do JavaScript e conferi a interface em uma captura mobile. Para esta versão, assumi uma música original sintetizada e uma única faixa jogável.
